[docs/events.md#queue]
On premises the same options are implemented by a file broker (`batch_size`, `batch_window`, visibility, dead-letter, `max_receive`, `fifo`). `BatchResult` retries only the failed message ids, as on AWS. Set `provider.options.services.queue` to `builtin` (created at start) or `{use: directory, path: ...}`. `existing: true` waits for that directory. Example: [`examples/04-queue-worker`](../examples/04-queue-worker) and [`examples/16-on-premises`](../examples/16-on-premises).

[docs/resource-guides/onprem/services.md#databases-one-server-or-a-primary-with-read-replicas]
- **Single server**: one container on this machine or a server. To scale it up, give that server more CPU and memory (vertical scaling). Nothing else changes. - **Primary + read replicas** (horizontal scaling): the **primary** takes every write, each **read replica** on another server keeps a copy and answers reads, and an optional **load balancer** gives the functions one address that sends writes to the primary and reads to the replicas. Add replicas later as reads grow.
